::error file=.mcp.json,line=7,title=SSG401::MCP server runs an npm package without an exact version: unpinned-npx: npx fixture-mcp-server. Pin the package to an exact version (name@1.2.3) so the code that runs cannot change without a commit.
::error file=.mcp.json,line=13,title=SSG402::MCP server runs a Python package without an exact version: unpinned-uvx: uvx fixture-mcp-tool. Pin the package to an exact version (name==1.2.3) in the uvx or pipx arguments.
::error file=.mcp.json,line=20,title=SSG403::MCP server package uses the latest tag: latest-tag: @fixture/server@latest. Replace @latest with an exact version; latest resolves to whatever was published most recently.
::error file=.mcp.json,line=25,title=SSG404::Remote MCP server without TLS: plain-http: http://mcp.example.invalid/mcp. Use https:// or wss:// for any server that is not on the loopback interface.
::warning file=.mcp.json,line=33,title=SSG406::MCP server runs a container image not pinned by digest: container-tag: ghcr.io/fixture/server:1.0. Reference the image as name@sha256:<digest> so a re-pushed tag cannot change what runs.
